Subject: Post-demo: Performance / SLO checklist & next steps (FintechCo)

Hi Priya / Alan —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap of the performance items we discussed and the proposed next steps so we can align on a testing plan and decision criteria. I attached a draft SLO checklist (20270305-fintechco-slo-checklist.pdf) — please skim and flag anything missing.

Key items we heard during the call:
- Latency target: 95th percentile < 200ms for single-turn (text-gen) workloads
- Streaming: token-level streaming required for chat use cases (low tail latency)
- Throughput: baseline 500 req/s, peak bursts up to 800 req/s
- Concurrency: typical concurrent sessions ~200, occasional spikes to 350

Proposed next steps (timeline):
1) FintechCo to share 24–72h sample traffic (anonymized) — Priya to confirm by EOD Mon (3/8)
2) Redwood to run a 30-minute soak + burst tests in a sandbox mirrored to your traffic profile (target completion: 3/12) — Rishi will own test plan
3) Run streaming token-latency checks and provide p50/p95/p99 for token latency and end-to-end response (3/12–3/15)
4) Cost/throughput estimate for Dedicated and Hosted fallbacks (3/16)
5) Decision meeting (FintechCo) by 3/22 — decision criteria in attached checklist

Questions for you now:
- Can you confirm sample traffic availability and whether you can provide a realistic token distribution (short queries vs. long multi-turn)?
- Are there any additional SLOs we should include (e.g., cold-start latency, hot-cache behavior)?
Thanks — looking forward to next steps.
Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and for sending the checklist. A few clarifications from our side after the demo:

- Latency: our product team is aiming for p95 end-to-end < 200ms for single-turn requests. For streaming (chat) we care about token emission latency — target ~ 50–100ms token-to-token in steady state.
- Throughput/concurrency: baseline 500 req/s is correct; we need to handle sustained 500 with bursts to 800 for scheduled jobs. Concurrency across users is ~200 typically; spikes to 300–350 are possible during market opens.
- Cold-starts: these are important for us — if a model shard is cold we want p95 cold-start under 1.5s.
We can provide a 48-hour anonymized traffic sample (CSV) and a token distribution file. We'll upload to the S3 link below by Monday 3/8 EOD.
Link: https://s3.fintechco.com/samples/traffic-202702.csv
Also, can Rishi share the perf test plan (tooling, metrics, and expected environment)? We may want our SRE on the sync.
Thanks,
Priya
Product Lead, Integrations | FintechCo
priya@fintechco.com

Thanks Marissa / Priya — looping in a quick technical plan.

Short answer: Verified feasible with some configuration. A few notes and assumptions:
- Model variant: We'll run tests against the LlamaV3-13B quantized variant for parity with your demo. If you need a larger variant we should budget for higher memory and different kernel selections.
- Batching: With your typical token distribution, continuous batching + adaptive flush should hit ~500 req/s on a 4xA100 Dedicated pool; bursts to 800 will require autoscale/burst policy.
- Streaming: We'll enable low-latency streaming path (no large prefetched batches) — expect token emission p50 ~40–60ms, p95 ~120–180ms depending on sequence length.
- Cold start: we'll test warm vs. cold with a worker spin-up; aim p95 < 1.5s by pre-warming and min-replicas.

Proposed perf test plan (attached: perf-test-plan.md):
1) Mirror anonymized traffic (24–48h) at 1x and 2x scale for soak tests (30 minutes run + 3x burst windows)
2) Measure: request p50/p95/p99, token emission p50/p95, error rate, CPU/GPU utilization, mem pressure, KV cache hit rate
3) Run streaming token-latency microbench for representative prompts (short, medium, long)
4) Produce a short report with plots and config recommendations (quant, batch sizes, min-replicas)

We should confirm:
- where we should push test results (your S3 link or Redwood Drive)
- whether FintechCo prefers Dedicated estimate or hosted+reserved fallback pricing in the report
I'll start drafting the test harness this week and target a sandbox run by 3/12.
— Rishi

Attachment: perf-test-plan.md

- Error rate < 0.1% under baseline load; graceful degradation strategy for bursts
